acceptanceCriteria: Rebind reuses query and impact results keyed by tree and input digests and recomputes on any change
A test proves a changed input forces recomputation
Measured finish time drop on the 72-hunk fixture recorded
body: Found by lane dogfood-perf-1021g (PR #1451, V1-1664). After #1451 the bind pass skips query/impact/local outcome, but the rebind step still recomputes query and impact for a tree the prepare pass already evaluated. Expected: reuse when the tree and inputs are byte-identical, recompute otherwise. Version: origin/main 8def072 + #1451.

completion.reason: Already delivered on main by #1451 (merge 5080bd4b0, DCW-V0-115): query and impact run once per finish in the rebind; lane dogfood-perf-1021o verified against ef2a01db5 (PR #1472 report).

title: dogfood-finish rebind recomputes query and impact that the prepare pass already produced for the same tree
